cards.title: Mareep
cards.rules: Wild Mareep appeared! Grab it by the fluff and roll d6.

outcomes.instruction: Static shock to the nipples. Drink 3.
It headbutts you in the crotch. Drink 2.
Free wool sweater. Give 2.

cards.title: Unown
cards.rules: Unown used Sobriety Test! Recite the alphabet backwards. Drink 1 for each mistake.

cards.title: Smeargle
cards.rules: Smeargle used Sketch! Switch drinks with another player.

cards.title: Slowpoke
cards.rules: Slowpoke tails are valuable. Cut it off: drink 2. Dick. Leave it: give 1.

cards.title: Zubat
cards.rules: Another fucking Zubat. Roll d6: that's how many bit your neck.

dice.instruction: Drink {total}. You're a vampire now: bite someone's neck.

cards.title: Magikarp
cards.rules: Magikarp used Splash! ...but nothing happened.

cards.title: Hoothoot
cards.rules: Hoothoot comes out at night. Dark outside: give 2. Daylight: hoot like an owl and drink 2.

cards.title: Castform
cards.rules: Castform used Weather Ball! Clear outside: drink 2. Cloudy: give 2. Rain or snow: drink 3.

cards.title: Tauros
cards.rules: A wild Tauros appeared and instantly fled. Drink 2 for being too slow.

cards.title: Pikachu
cards.rules: You caught a Pikachu! Drink 2 and name your new starter. Electric typing included.

cards.title: Dragon Rage
cards.rules: Gyarados used Dragon Rage! Drink 4 and glare at someone.

cards.title: Red Gyarados
cards.rules: It's a Red Gyarados! If you've caught a shiny before, give 4. Otherwise, drink 4.

cards.title: Diglett
cards.rules: Diglett used Dig! Dig deep and finish your drink.

cards.title: Poliwag
cards.rules: Poliwag used Hydro Pump! Shotgun a beer.

cards.title: Electabuzz
cards.rules: Electabuzz used Thunder Punch! You're paralyzed. Drink 3.

cards.title: Miltank
cards.rules: Miltank used Milk Drink! Swap your drink for a non-alcoholic one and drink 2.

cards.title: Dragonite
cards.rules: Dragonite used Hyper Beam! Give 5, then drink 2 to recharge.

cards.title: Snorlax
cards.rules: A Snorlax blocks the path! Belt out a song of the group's choice or drink 4.

cards.title: Sentret
cards.rules: Sentret used Foresight! Choose someone who didn't see it coming; they drink 4.

cards.title: Krabby
cards.rules: Krabby used Crabhammer! Pick someone. They drink 5 or finish their drink.

cards.title: Fearow
cards.rules: Fearow used Mirror Move! Do whatever the last player did on their turn.

cards.title: Beedrill
cards.rules: Beedrill used Twinneedle! Pick two players. Both drink 2.

cards.title: Gloom
cards.rules: Gloom used Sludge Bomb! You and the two players beside you drink 4.

cards.title: Meowth
cards.rules: Meowth used Pay Day! Everyone but you drinks 1.

cards.title: Phanpy
cards.rules: A wild Phanpy appeared! Nose goes! Last finger to their nose drinks 2.

cards.title: Abra
cards.rules: Abra used Teleport! Everyone swaps seats. Last one seated drinks 2.

cards.title: Burned Tower
cards.rules: Burned Tower! Name all three legendary beasts. Last to do it drinks 3.

cards.title: Fossil Revival
cards.rules: You revived a Fossil Pokémon! Everyone older than you drinks 2.

cards.title: Cubone
cards.rules: Cubone used "My mother is dead." Share a depressing story. Then everyone drinks 1.

cards.title: Evolution
cards.rules: Your Pokémon is evolving! Let it evolve: drink 4. Cancel it: give 2.

cards.title: Starter
cards.rules: Choose your starter: drink 2 (grass), give 2 (fire), or everyone drinks 1 (water).

cards.title: Doduo
cards.rules: Doduo used Double-Edge! Give 4 drinks, then drink 1.

cards.title: Lickitung
cards.rules: Lickitung used Lick! Lick your lips at the player across from you, then give them 2.

cards.title: Pokédex
cards.rules: Going clockwise, name Pokémon in Pokédex order. First to repeat or skip a number drinks 2.

cards.title: Type Matchup
cards.rules: Name a type. Going clockwise, name a Pokémon of that type. Repeat or blank: drink 2.

cards.title: Who's That?
cards.rules: Describe a Pokémon without naming it. First to guess gives 2. Nobody guesses? Drink 2.

cards.title: Evolution Line
cards.rules: Name a three-stage evolution line. No repeats. First to blank or repeat drinks 2.

cards.title: Cry Alike
cards.rules: Make a Pokémon cry. First to name it gives 2. Whoever is wrong drinks 2.

cards.title: Rival Silver
cards.rules: Rival Silver appears. Drink half the table, rounded up. He's still smug.

cards.title: Rival Wally
cards.rules: Rival Wally has asthma and one Ralts. Roll d6: that's how many puffs he needs.

cards.title: Rival May
cards.rules: Rival May blocks the path! Everyone taken drinks 3. Nobody's taken: everyone drinks 5.

cards.title: Team Rocket
cards.rules: Team Rocket blasts off! Everyone recites the motto. Last to finish drinks 2.

cards.title: Rocket Grunt
cards.rules: A Rocket Grunt sends five Rattata. Drink as many as you want, then laugh at him.

cards.title: Team Magma
cards.rules: Team Magma recruited you! Everyone in red joins: you all give 3. Nobody in red: drink 4.

cards.title: Team Aqua
cards.rules: Team Aqua recruited you! Everyone in blue joins: you all give 3. Nobody in blue: drink 4.

cards.title: Pokémon Master
cards.rules: Throw the Master Ball! Take 2 victory drinks while everyone toasts you.

cards.title: Champion Lance
cards.rules: Champion Lance! Finish a full drink to take his title, or drink 6.

cards.title: Elite Four
cards.rules: Challenge the Elite Four with an underleveled team. Roll 4d6.

outcomes.instruction: You win! Give 4 and make a speech.
Bruno beats your ass. Drink 4.

cards.title: Gym Battle
cards.rules: Gym battle! Roll d6 to see what's on your team.

outcomes.instruction: Six Magikarp. Finish your drink.
You lose and pay the leader. Drink 3.
Ugly win. Give 2.
Clean sweep. Give 4 and strike a pose.

cards.title: Delibird
cards.rules: Delibird used Present! Roll d6 and open it.

outcomes.instruction: It's a bomb. Drink {total}.
It's a gift. Give {total}.

cards.title: Raikou
cards.rules: Raikou appears! Roll d6. 3: catch it and give 5. Anything else: take a bomb shot.

outcomes.instruction: Zapped. Take a bomb shot.
Caught it! Give 5.
Zapped. Take a bomb shot.

cards.title: Entei
cards.rules: Entei appears! Roll d6. 3: catch it and give 5. Anything else: take a high-proof shot.

outcomes.instruction: Burned. Take a high-proof shot.
Caught it! Give 5.
Burned. Take a high-proof shot.

cards.title: Suicune
cards.rules: Suicune appears! Roll d6. 3: catch it and give 5. Anything else: shotgun a beer.

outcomes.instruction: Blitzed. Shotgun a beer.
Caught it! Give 5.
Blitzed. Shotgun a beer.

cards.title: Kyogre
cards.rules: Kyogre rises from the sea! Roll d6. 5-6: catch it; give 5. 1-4: soaked; shotgun a beer.

outcomes.instruction: Soaked. Shotgun a beer.
Caught it! Give 5.

cards.title: Groudon
cards.rules: Groudon wakes! Roll d6. 4-6: catch it; give 4. 1-3: rocked; take a high-proof shot.

outcomes.instruction: Rocked. Take a high-proof shot.
Caught it! Give 4.

cards.title: Rayquaza
cards.rules: Rayquaza descends! Roll d6. 6: catch it; give 6. 1-5: dropped; take a bomb shot.

outcomes.instruction: Dropped. Take a bomb shot.
Caught it! Give 6.

cards.title: Game Corner
cards.rules: The Game Corner slots are rigged by Team Rocket. Roll 2d6 anyway.

outcomes.instruction: The house wins. Drink 2.
Jackpot! Give 7.
The house wins. Drink 2.

cards.title: Bug Catching Contest
cards.rules: Bug Catching Contest! Roll d6: Paras, Metapod, Beedrill, Butterfree, Pinsir or Scyther.

outcomes.instruction: Paras: awful. Drink 1.
Metapod: give 1.
Beedrill: drink 1, give 1.
Butterfree: give 2.
Pinsir: drink 2, give 1.
Scyther: give 3.

cards.title: Safari Zone
cards.rules: Safari Zone! Roll d6. 1-2: bait; give 1. 3-4: throw a rock, dick; drink 4. 5-6: ball; drink 2.

outcomes.instruction: Bait. Give 1.
Rock! Dick move. Drink 4.
Safari Ball. Drink 2.

cards.title: Rattata
cards.rules: Rattata used Tackle! Roll d6. 1: you fainted; finish your drink. 2-6: give 1.

outcomes.instruction: You fainted. Finish your drink.
Give 1.

cards.title: Chansey
cards.rules: Chansey hands you her egg. Don't ask where it came from. Roll d6.

outcomes.instruction: You drop it. Drink 3, egg murderer.
She takes it back. Drink 1.
Lucky Egg! Give 4.

cards.title: Poké Ball
cards.rules: Throw a Poké Ball! Roll d6.

outcomes.instruction: You nail the trainer in the balls. You both drink 2.
It flees. Drink 3.
Caught it! Give 3 and name it after someone here.

cards.title: Supersonic
cards.rules: Tentacool used Supersonic! You're confused. Roll d6.

outcomes.instruction: You hurt yourself in confusion. Drink 4.
Drink 2 with your other hand.
You snap out of it. Give 2.

cards.title: Missingno
cards.rules: A wild Missingno glitched in! Roll d20. 1-5: game breaks, everyone drinks 3. 6+: drink 2.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! The game breaks hard. Everyone drinks 6.
The game breaks. Everyone drinks 3.
Drink 2.

cards.title: Pineco
cards.rules: Pineco used Protect! Drink 2. Until your next turn, ignore every drink given to you.

cards.title: Farfetch'd
cards.rules: Farfetch'd got away! Drink 1, then fetch the next drink anyone asks for.

cards.title: Raticate
cards.rules: Raticate used Pursuit! For the rest of the game, drink 1 whenever you leave the table.

cards.title: Mankey
cards.rules: Mankey used Swagger! Teach a handshake. Until your next turn, fumbles drink 1.

cards.title: Aipom
cards.rules: Aipom used Baton Pass! Until your next turn, pass every drink you're given to another player.

cards.title: Skarmory
cards.rules: Steel Wing! Drink 3. Until your next turn, drinks given to you bounce to your right neighbor.

cards.title: Tropius
cards.rules: Tropius used Sweet Scent! Until your next turn, every drink given out comes to you instead.

cards.title: Sandshrew
cards.rules: Sandshrew used Sand-Attack! Drink with your non-dominant hand for the rest of the game.

cards.title: Vulpix
cards.rules: Vulpix used Will-O-Wisp! You are burned: drink 3 while the table fans you.

cards.title: Shuppet
cards.rules: Shuppet used Curse! For the rest of the game, drink 1 every time you curse.

cards.title: Ditto
cards.rules: Ditto used Transform! Impersonate someone here; the table guesses. Nobody gets it: drink 2.

cards.title: Psyduck
cards.rules: Psyduck has a headache! Hold your head, groan "Psyyy", then drink 2.

cards.title: Lapras
cards.rules: Lapras used Confuse Ray! Pick a player: questions only until your next turn, or drink 1.

cards.title: Tentacool
cards.rules: Tentacool used Constrict! Drink 2 and hold your drink until you finish it.

cards.title: Egg
cards.rules: You got an Egg! Cradle your drink like a baby, sing it one line of a lullaby, then drink 2.

cards.title: Togepi
cards.rules: Togepi hatched! Make a new rule for the rest of the game. Violations: drink 1.

cards.title: Eevee
cards.rules: Eeveelution time! Choose a new rule for the rest of the game. Violations: drink 1.

cards.title: Trick House
cards.rules: The Trick House! Make a tricky new rule for the rest of the game. Violations: drink 1.

cards.title: Pokémon Tower
cards.rules: Out of respect for the dead: no talking until your next turn. Slip and drink 1.

cards.title: Machoke
cards.rules: Machoke used Submission! Do anything the group tells you now, or drink 4.

cards.title: Marill
cards.rules: Rain Dance! Perform a song and dance the group chooses, or drink 3.

cards.title: Geodude
cards.rules: Magnitude! Drink any number; your left neighbor drinks one less, and so on around the table.

cards.title: Wartortle
cards.rules: Wartortle used Skull Bash! Crush a can on your head and give 3 to a player, or drink 3.

cards.title: Ursaring
cards.rules: Ursaring woke up angry! Drink as many as the group decides, and apologize.

cards.title: Day Care
cards.rules: You visited the Day Care! Give 1 for each sibling you have. None? Drink 2.

cards.title: Clefairy
cards.rules: Clefairy used Metronome! Close your eyes and point at a player. Whoever you touch drinks 3.

cards.title: Razor Leaf
cards.rules: Bellsprout used Razor Leaf! Shred someone with a callout. They drink 1 in shame.

cards.title: Murkrow
cards.rules: Murkrow used Mimic! Say a player's last sentence in their voice. Bad impression: drink 2.

cards.title: Sudowoodo
cards.rules: Sudowoodo blocks the path! Drink 2, or spill an embarrassing truth and everyone else drinks.

cards.title: Whismur
cards.rules: Whismur used Uproar! The group picks a phrase. Shout it up to 3 times; give that many drinks.

cards.title: Plusle & Minun
cards.rules: Plusle and Minun used Helping Hand! Pick a player. The next time they drink, drink for them.

cards.title: Zigzagoon
cards.rules: Zigzagoon used Growl! Bark at the group. Last to bark back drinks 2.

cards.title: Wailmer
cards.rules: Wailmer used Whirlpool! Give 3 to the player on your right. They're dizzy.

cards.title: Contest Hall
cards.rules: Hoenn Contest Hall! Runway walk to a song the table picks. Do it: give 5. Don't: drink 3.

cards.title: Spinda
cards.rules: Spinda used Teeter Dance! Dance to a group-chosen song or drink 8.

cards.title: Bicycle
cards.rules: I want to ride my BICYCLE! Sing the line or drink 3. Anyone who joins in drinks 1.

cards.title: Spoink
cards.rules: Spoink's Psychic! Guess the fingers behind your back. Wrong: drink that many. Right: they do.

cards.title: Seaking
cards.rules: Seaking used Waterfall! Everyone drinks; nobody stops until the player before them does.

cards.title: Spheal
cards.rules: Spheal used Ice Ball! Drink 1, your left neighbor 2, the next 3, and so on around the table.

cards.title: Clamperl
cards.rules: Clamperl is evolving! Choose: all girls drink 3, or all guys drink 3.

cards.title: Luvdisc
cards.rules: Luvdisc used Splash! It's super effective: everyone finishes their drinks.

cards.title: Electrode
cards.rules: Electrode used Selfdestruct! Choose a player and you both finish your drinks.

cards.title: Claydol
cards.rules: Claydol used Double-Edge! Give any number of drinks, then drink half that, rounded up.

cards.title: Rare Candy
cards.rules: Rare Candy! Level up: take another card now. No passing the device.

cards.title: Bellsprout
cards.rules: Bellsprout used Growth! Drink 1 and take another card now.

cards.title: Jigglypuff
cards.rules: Jigglypuff used Sing! Everyone else fell asleep. Take another card now.

cards.title: Pound
cards.rules: Jigglypuff used Pound! Everyone pounds the table. Last to pound drinks 2.

cards.title: Grimer
cards.rules: Grimer used Sludge Bomb! Have every player combine their drinks in a glass, then finish it!

cards.title: Pelipper
cards.rules: Pelipper used Stockpile! Mix a splash of everyone's drink, then roll d6 to see who swallows it.

outcomes.instruction: Spit Up! Choose who drinks it.
Swallow it.

cards.title: Shroomish
cards.rules: Shroomish used Leech Seed! Take a drink from somebody else's cup.

cards.title: Barboach
cards.rules: Barboach used Mud-slap! Pick a player. Rest of the game: they get one slap after a full drink.

cards.title: Mawile
cards.rules: Mawile used Vicegrip! Give your left neighbor a 3-second bear hug, then drink 4 and apologize.

cards.title: Fiery Path
cards.rules: Fiery Path! Take off an article of clothing. Drink 4 to stay hydrated.

cards.title: Relicanth
cards.rules: Relicanth used Dive! Under the table, hold your breath 10 seconds. Surface early: drink 2.

cards.title: Koffing
cards.rules: Koffing used Haze! If there's anything nearby to smoke, smoke it to avoid 2 drinks.

cards.title: Battle of the Sexes
cards.rules: Your side drinks 2: guys if you're a guy, girls if you're a girl. The other side gives 1 each.

cards.title: Bulbasaur
cards.rules: Bulbasaur chose you. Everyone sniff the bulb. Max HP 15. Every heal heals 2 more.

evolves.title: Ivysaur
evolves.rules: Max HP 17. Every heal heals 2 more.

evolves.title: Venusaur
evolves.rules: Max HP 19. Every heal heals 3 more.

cards.title: Charmander
cards.rules: Charmander chose you. Keep its tail lit. +2 to route battle rolls. Bosses hurt 1 more.

evolves.title: Charmeleon
evolves.rules: Max HP 18. +2 to route battle rolls.

evolves.title: Charizard
evolves.rules: Max HP 19. +2 to route battle rolls. +1 to boss rolls.

cards.title: Squirtle
cards.rules: Squirtle chose you, in sunglasses. The bag holds 2. Starts with a Protect.

evolves.title: Wartortle
evolves.rules: Max HP 17. A fresh Protect at every gym.

evolves.title: Blastoise
evolves.rules: Max HP 17. A fresh Protect at every gym. The bag holds 4.

cards.title: Pikachu
cards.rules: Pikachu won't evolve. Ever. Max HP 18. +1 to every battle roll. Natural 20 on a 19 or 20.

cards.title: Eevee
cards.rules: Eevee chose you. The table picks what it evolves into. Max HP 15. The bag holds 4.

evolves.title: Vaporeon
evolves.rules: Max HP 20. Every heal heals 2 more. The bag holds 4.

evolves.title: Jolteon
evolves.rules: Max HP 17. +1 to every battle roll. The bag holds 4.

evolves.title: Flareon
evolves.rules: Max HP 18. Natural 20 on a 19 or 20. The bag holds 4.

cards.title: Cyndaquil
cards.rules: Cyndaquil chose you, half asleep. Max HP 16. Starts with an X Attack.

evolves.title: Quilava
evolves.rules: Max HP 17.

evolves.title: Typhlosion
evolves.rules: Max HP 19. A fresh X Attack at every gym.

cards.title: Totodile
cards.rules: Totodile chose you by biting you. Max HP 20. Route battles hurt 1 more.

evolves.title: Croconaw
evolves.rules: Max HP 22. Route battles hurt 1 more.

evolves.title: Feraligatr
evolves.rules: Max HP 23. +1 to boss rolls.

cards.title: Treecko
cards.rules: Treecko chose you, unbothered. Ace Trainers and rivals hurt 1 more. Starts with an Escape Rope.

evolves.title: Grovyle
evolves.rules: Max HP 18.

evolves.title: Sceptile
evolves.rules: Max HP 19. A fresh Escape Rope at every gym. The bag holds 4.

cards.title: Torchic
cards.rules: Torchic chose you. Everyone flap and peep. Max HP 15. +2 to Ace Trainer and rival rolls.

evolves.title: Combusken
evolves.rules: Max HP 17. +2 to Ace Trainer and rival rolls.

evolves.title: Blaziken
evolves.rules: Max HP 19. +1 to every battle roll. +2 to Ace Trainer and rival rolls.

cards.title: Mudkip
cards.rules: So I herd u liek Mudkipz. Max HP 11. Bosses hurt 1 less.

evolves.title: Marshtomp
evolves.rules: Max HP 13. Bosses hurt 1 less.

evolves.title: Swampert
evolves.rules: Max HP 17. +1 to boss rolls. Bosses hurt 1 less.

cards.title: Piplup
cards.rules: Piplup chose you, proudly. Max HP 23. Bosses take 1 more hit. Starts with a Protect.

evolves.title: Prinplup
evolves.rules: Max HP 23. Bosses take 1 more hit.

evolves.title: Empoleon
evolves.rules: Max HP 23. Bosses hurt 1 less.

cards.title: Turtwig
cards.rules: Turtwig chose you, slowly. Max HP 21. The bag holds 2.

evolves.title: Grotle
evolves.rules: Max HP 22.

evolves.title: Torterra
evolves.rules: Max HP 23. The bag holds 4.

cards.title: Oshawott
cards.rules: Oshawott chose you, scalchop out. Max HP 14. Starts with a Protect and an X Attack.

evolves.title: Dewott
evolves.rules: Max HP 16.

evolves.title: Samurott
evolves.rules: Max HP 18. Natural 20 on a 19 or 20.

cards.title: Froakie
cards.rules: Froakie chose you, covered in bubbles. Max HP 15. Starts with a Rare Candy.

evolves.title: Frogadier
evolves.rules: Max HP 16. +1 to route battle rolls.

evolves.title: Greninja
evolves.rules: Max HP 18. +2 to route battle rolls. Natural 20 on a 19 or 20.

cards.title: Rowlet
cards.rules: Rowlet chose you and fell asleep on your head. Max HP 16. Hazards and finds hurt 1 less.

evolves.title: Dartrix
evolves.rules: Max HP 17. Hazards and finds hurt 1 less.

evolves.title: Decidueye
evolves.rules: Max HP 19. +2 to hazard and find rolls. Hazards and finds hurt 1 less.

cards.title: Scorbunny
cards.rules: Scorbunny chose you. Boing. Route battles and trainer challenges hurt 1 less. The bag holds 2.

evolves.title: Raboot
evolves.rules: Max HP 18. +1 to every battle roll. Route battles and trainer challenges hurt 1 less.

evolves.title: Cinderace
evolves.rules: Max HP 19. +1 to every battle roll. Natural 20 on a 19 or 20. Route battles and trainer challenges hurt 1 less.

cards.title: Fuecoco
cards.rules: Fuecoco chose you because you had snacks. Starts with 2 Potions.

evolves.title: Crocalor
evolves.rules: Max HP 18.

evolves.title: Skeledirge
evolves.rules: Max HP 20. Every heal heals 1 more.

cards.title: Bidoof
cards.rules: Nobody chooses Bidoof. Max HP 15. −1 to boss rolls. Every 20 is rerolled. The bag holds 2.

evolves.title: Bibarel
evolves.rules: Max HP 14. −1 to boss rolls. Every 20 is rerolled. The bag holds 2.

cards.title: Magikarp
cards.rules: Magikarp chose you. It used Splash. Nothing happened. Max HP 15. −1 to every battle roll.

evolves.title: Gyarados
evolves.rules: Max HP 20. +1 to every battle roll.

cards.title: Wooper
cards.rules: Wooper chose you. It does nothing, but it's very happy to be here.

evolves.title: Quagsire
evolves.rules: Max HP 17.

cards.title: Sunkern
cards.rules: Sunkern chose you. It is a seed with a face. Max HP 15.

evolves.title: Sunflora
evolves.rules: Max HP 16.

cards.title: Slowpoke
cards.rules: Slowpoke chose you. Eventually. Every heal heals 2 more. Bosses take 1 more hit.

evolves.title: Slowbro
evolves.rules: Max HP 18. Every heal heals 2 more.

cards.title: Psyduck
cards.rules: Psyduck chose you. It has a headache. So do you. Max HP 20. Natural 1 on a 1 or 2.

evolves.title: Golduck
evolves.rules: Max HP 20. +1 to every battle roll.

cards.title: Pidgey
cards.rules: Wild Pidgey appeared! Shield your eyes and roll d6 for its move.

outcomes.instruction: Sand Attack, right in the eyes. Drink 2 with them shut.
Gust. Your hair is ruined. Give 1.
Tackle. Adorable. Give 2.
Quick Attack, into a window. Give 2.
It pecks your left neighbor instead. They drink 2.
Whirlwind blows it into the next town. Give 3.

cards.title: Rattata
cards.rules: Wild Rattata appeared! It is chewing on your shoelaces like it pays rent. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It bites your ankle. Drink 4 standing on one foot.
It bites your ankle. Drink 2 standing on one foot.
Evicted. Whoever has the worst shoes drinks 2.
Natural 20! Evicted. Whoever has the worst shoes drinks 4.

cards.title: Zigzagoon
cards.rules: Wild Zigzagoon is zigzagging toward you. Zigzag your head with it and roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You zag straight into a wall. Drink 3 and sit on the floor.
Dizzy. Drink {total}.
Pickup! Steal a sip from any drink at the table.
Natural 20! Pickup! Steal two sips from any drink at the table.

cards.title: Bidoof
cards.rules: Wild Bidoof appeared, with the dead eyes of a man on his fourth divorce. Roll 2d6.

outcomes.instruction: It stares into your soul. Drink 2 without blinking.
Bidoof wanders off to find wife five. Give 2.

dice.doubles: A pair! Bidoof proposes. Your left neighbor officiates and drinks 3.

cards.title: Wooloo
cards.rules: Wild Wooloo rolls at you like a drunk sheep down a hill. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Bowled over. Drink 4, then baa like you mean it.
Bowled over. Drink 2, then baa like you mean it.
You hop it like a hurdle. Give 2.
Natural 20! You shear it and keep the sweater. Give 4.

cards.title: Lechonk
cards.rules: Wild Lechonk is snorting your snacks. Everyone oinks at it; the drawer rolls d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It eats the whole bag. Oink, then drink 4.
It eats the whole bag. Oink, then drink 2.
Bacon later. The quietest oinker drinks 2.
Natural 20! Bacon later. The quietest oinker drinks 4.

cards.title: Youngster Joey
cards.rules: Joey says his Rattata is in the top percentage of Rattata. Prove him wrong. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It was. Drink 6 and apologize to Joey.
It was. Drink 3 and apologize to Joey.
Top percentage, bottom of the bracket. Give 2.
Natural 20! Top percentage, bottom of the bracket. Give 4.

cards.title: Bug Catcher
cards.rules: A kid in short shorts bets you can't name five bug Pokémon in 10 seconds. Lose: drink 2.

cards.title: One-Way Ledge
cards.rules: You hop the ledge and can never go back up. Your ankle has opinions. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Rolled it. Drink 4 standing on your good foot.
Rolled it. Drink 2 standing on your good foot.
Stuck the landing. Give 1 and take a bow.
Natural 20! Stuck the landing. Give 2 and take a bow.

cards.title: Caterpie
cards.rules: A Caterpie is just sitting there being a little guy. Will the table catch it?

cards.title: Mystery Egg
cards.rules: A stranger in a trench coat hands you an egg. It's warm. Too warm.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It hatches into a Togepi and pisses on you. Drink 6.
It hatches into a Togepi and pisses on you. Drink 3.
It's a pack of ammo for the bag. Give 2.
Natural 20! It's a pack of ammo for the bag. Give 4.

cards.title: Potion on the Ground
cards.rules: Someone dropped a Potion in the grass. Finders keepers. Everyone drinks 1 to celebrate.

cards.title: Viridian Center
cards.rules: Nurse Joy takes your team and gives it back in five seconds. Everyone toasts Nurse Joy.

cards.title: Viridian Mart
cards.rules: The clerk won't sell you anything until you deliver Oak's parcel. Fine. Here's the parcel.

cards.title: Two Paths
cards.rules: A short path through tall grass, or a long one past a kid yelling about his Pokémon.

elite.title: Ace Trainer Kenny
elite.rules: Kenny has trained since he was four, and his Rattata is in its prime. Roll d6.

outcomes.instruction: He explains EV training at length. Drink 3.
Rattata crits. Drink 3 and say "good game, Kenny."
Kenny cries. Give 3.
Kenny calls his mom. Give 3.
Kenny quits forever. Give 4.
Kenny gives you his hat. Give 4.

elite.title: Lass Tiffany
elite.rules: Lass Tiffany says you looked at her. Battle to prove you didn't. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You did. Drink 6, and look only at the floor until your next turn.
You did. Drink 3, and look only at the floor until your next turn.
She leaves you a Protect out of respect. Give 3.
Natural 20! She leaves you a Protect out of respect. Give 6.

cards.title: Brock
cards.rules: Brock is busy hitting on Nurse Joy. Hit on someone here for him, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Onix flattens you. Drink 10.
Onix flattens you. Drink 5.
You chip through. Drink 2.
Natural 20! Critical hit. Give 6.

cards.title: Falkner
cards.rules: Drink 3 standing on one foot. Touch down before you finish and you lose: drink 3 more.

cards.title: Roxanne
cards.rules: Name 8 Pokémon types in 10 seconds. Drink 2 for each one you miss.

cards.title: Roark
cards.rules: Roark shines his miner's headlamp right in your eyes. Squint at him, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Black lung. Finish your drink.
Cave-in. Drink 4 with your eyes shut.
You strike coal. Shine your phone light on a player; they drink 3.
Natural 20! You strike coal. Shine your phone light on a player; they drink 6.

cards.title: Cilan, Chili & Cress
cards.rules: Waiters' test: recite everyone's drink in seat order. Each miss: drink 2. Two misses lose.

cards.title: Viola
cards.rules: Viola's photo shoot: hold a pose for 30 seconds while the table heckles. Laugh: drink 4.

cards.title: Ilima
cards.rules: Ilima is pretty and knows it. Compliment yourself for 10 seconds straight, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Totem Gumshoos. Drink 8 and compliment your left neighbor.
Totem Gumshoos. Drink 4 and compliment your left neighbor.
Trial cleared. Pick a player: they compliment themselves for 10 seconds or drink 3.
Natural 20! Prettier than Ilima. Give 6.

cards.title: Milo
cards.rules: Milo herds Wooloo. Baa like a sheep for 20 seconds. Nobody laughs: drink 4.

cards.title: Katy
cards.rules: Katy's bugs got in the cake batter. Take a big bite of nothing, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You found a leg. Finish your drink.
Sticky Web. Drink 4 with your elbows stuck to the table.
Sugar crash for Katy. Give 3.
Natural 20! Sugar crash for Katy. Give 6.

cards.title: Spearow
cards.rules: Wild Spearow is angrier than any bird has a right to be. Roll d6 for its move.

outcomes.instruction: Fury Attack: four pecks. Drink 4.
Peck. Rude. Give 1.
Leer. You leer back harder. Give 2.
Growl. Everyone growls at it; the quietest drinks 2.
It flies off to bother Ash. Give 2.
Drill Peck misses and hits your right neighbor. They drink 3.

cards.title: Ekans
cards.rules: Wild Ekans wraps around your leg and hisses something filthy. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Wrap. Drink 4, and drink with crossed arms until your next turn.
Wrap. Drink 2, and drink with crossed arms until your next turn.
You tie it in a knot. Give 2.
Natural 20! You tie it in a knot. Give 4.

cards.title: Wurmple
cards.rules: Wild Wurmple appeared! Nobody knows what it becomes. Not even Wurmple. Roll 2d6.

outcomes.instruction: Existential dread. Drink 2 and name your biggest regret.
It becomes a footnote. Give 2.

dice.doubles: A pair! It evolves mid-fight into something nobody predicted. Give {total}.

cards.title: Starly
cards.rules: A whole flock of Starly. Everyone flaps their arms. The drawer rolls d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Swarmed. Drink 4; the worst flapper drinks with you.
Swarmed. Drink 2; the worst flapper drinks with you.
They scatter. The last one still flapping drinks 2.
Natural 20! They scatter. The last one still flapping drinks 4.

cards.title: Lillipup
cards.rules: Wild Lillipup wants belly rubs. Rub the nearest belly at the table, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It humps your leg. Drink 4 and apologize to the leg.
It humps your leg. Drink 2 and apologize to the leg.
Good dog. You and the belly you rubbed give 2 each.
Natural 20! Good dog. You and the belly you rubbed give 4 each.

cards.title: Yungoos
cards.rules: Wild Yungoos is a sausage with teeth and a bad attitude. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It bites your sausage. Drink 6 with your legs crossed.
It bites your sausage. Drink 3 with your legs crossed.
Sausage served. Whoever has the longest name drinks 2.
Natural 20! Sausage served. Whoever has the longest name drinks 4.

cards.title: Hiker Dave
cards.rules: Hiker Dave hasn't showered since Mt. Moon and wants a hug. Hug your left neighbor, roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Geodude to the face. Drink 6 and hug him again.
Geodude to the face. Drink 3 and hug him again.
Dave heads back up the mountain. Your left neighbor drinks 2 for the smell.
Natural 20! Dave heads back up the mountain. Your left neighbor drinks 4 for the smell.

cards.title: Picnicker Gina
cards.rules: Picnicker Gina dares you to eat something off the floor. Do it or drink 3.

cards.title: Zubat Cave
cards.rules: Mt. Moon. No Repel. Zubat every step. Roll d6 for how many.

outcomes.instruction: Six Zubat. Drink 3 and bite a neck.
Five Zubat. Drink 2, flapping.
Two Zubat. Give 1.
One Zubat. Give 1.
A Clefairy instead. Give 2.
No Zubat at all. A miracle. Give 3.

cards.title: Clefairy
cards.rules: A Clefairy is dancing under the moon. It's beautiful. Wipe a tear and decide.

cards.title: Rare Candy
cards.rules: A Rare Candy on the ground, a little linty. Your starter is staring at it.

cards.title: Pewter Center
cards.rules: The Pokémon Center smells like antiseptic and Brock's cologne. Everyone breathes in.

cards.title: Pewter Mart
cards.rules: The Pewter Mart only sells rocks, Potions and something called an Escape Rope.

cards.title: Mt. Moon Fork
cards.rules: Through the cave, or around it past a Super Nerd guarding a fossil.

cards.title: Shiny Rock
cards.rules: You find a shiny rock and decide it's an X Attack now. The drawer gives 1.

elite.title: Super Nerd Miguel
elite.rules: Miguel will fight you for the Helix Fossil. He's been here for weeks. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He wins and explains why. Drink 6 and say "Praise Helix."
He wins and explains why. Drink 3 and say "Praise Helix."
You take the fossil. Everyone yells "Praise Helix!"; the last one drinks 3.
Natural 20! You take the fossil. Everyone yells "Praise Helix!"; the last one drinks 6.

elite.title: Twins Amy & May
elite.rules: Double battle, and both twins talk at once. Pick a partner, then roll 2d6.

outcomes.instruction: Two on two, and you lost. You and your partner drink 3.
Both twins cry in stereo. You and your partner give 2 each.

dice.doubles: A pair! Perfect sync. You and your partner give {total} between you.

cards.title: Misty
cards.rules: Misty's Cascade. Chug for 10 seconds without stopping. Stop early: drink 4 more.

cards.title: Bugsy
cards.rules: Bugsy's bugs got in your pants. Roll 3d6 and check your shorts.

outcomes.instruction: Bitten. Drink 2.
Bitten. Drink 2.
Bitten. Drink 3.
Bitten. Drink 3.
Bitten. Drink 4.
Bitten. Drink 4.
Bitten. Drink 5.
Bitten. Drink 5.
You squash them. Give 4.

cards.title: Brawly
cards.rules: Ten push-ups in 20 seconds. Fall short: drink 6.

cards.title: Gardenia
cards.rules: Gardenia fears ghosts. Tell her a ghost story in 20 seconds. Table votes not scary: drink 4.

cards.title: Lenora
cards.rules: Lenora runs a museum and you're the exhibit. Hold a statue pose while you roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Retaliate. Drink 8 without breaking the pose.
Retaliate. Drink 4 without breaking the pose.
You beat the curator. Give 4.
Natural 20! Masterpiece. Give 8.

cards.title: Grant
cards.rules: Grant makes you climb. Crawl under the table and out the other side, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You fall off the wall. Drink 8 from under the table.
You fall off the wall. Drink 4 from under the table.
You top out. Give 4.
Natural 20! Free solo. Give 8.

cards.title: Hala
cards.rules: Hala wants sumo. Palm-push your right neighbor; first to move a foot loses. Lose: drink 5.

cards.title: Nessa
cards.rules: Nessa is a model and you are not. Pout for the camera, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Gigantamax Drednaw. Finish your drink.
Drowned in looks. Drink 4 and keep pouting.
You make the cover. Pick a player: they strike a pose or drink 3.
Natural 20! You make the cover. Pick a player: they strike a pose or drink 6.

cards.title: Brassius
cards.rules: Brassius demands art. Napkin-sculpt a Pokémon in 20 seconds. Nobody can name it: drink 4.

cards.title: Psyduck
cards.rules: Wild Psyduck has a headache. So do you. Hold your head and roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Confusion. Drink 6.
Confusion. Drink 3.
It waddles off, still confused. Give 2.
Natural 20! It waddles off, still confused. Give 4.

jinx.name: Question Time
jinx.rule: The jinxed player speaks only in questions. Slip: drink 1.

cards.title: Machop
cards.rules: Wild Machop wants to arm-wrestle. Flex for the table, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Karate Chop to the junk. Drink 6 and say "thank you, sensei."
Karate Chop to the junk. Drink 3 and say "thank you, sensei."
You flex harder. Give 2.
Natural 20! You flex harder. Give 4.

cards.title: Shinx
cards.rules: Wild Shinx sparks when it sees you. Every hair on your body stands up. Roll d6.

outcomes.instruction: Spark. Drink 3.
Shock. You and both neighbors drink 1.
You pet the spark out of it. Give 2.
It zaps your left neighbor instead. They drink 2.
Charge. It's still charging. Give 2.
It falls asleep in your lap. Give 3.

cards.title: Roggenrola
cards.rules: Wild Roggenrola is a rock with an ear. It heard what you said about it. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It tells everyone. Drink 4, and tell the table one thing you've said behind someone's back.
It tells everyone. Drink 2, and tell the table one thing you've said behind someone's back.
You skip it across a pond. Give 2.
Natural 20! You skip it across a pond. Give 4.

cards.title: Pikipek
cards.rules: Wild Pikipek is drilling into a tree. Then your skull. Knock on the table, roll 2d6.

outcomes.instruction: Woodpecked. Drink 3.
It finds a better tree. Give 2.

dice.doubles: A pair! It drums a beat. Everyone drums the table; the last to stop drinks 3.

cards.title: Nickit
cards.rules: Wild Nickit steals the drink nearest the drawer. Roll d20 to get it back.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It's gone. Finish whatever you have, then a fresh one.
It's gone. Finish whatever you have.
Recovered, with a tip. Give 3.
Natural 20! Recovered, with a tip. Give 6.

cards.title: Swimmer Brad
cards.rules: Swimmer Brad is in a Speedo on dry land and won't explain. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You looked. Drink 6 and describe what you saw.
You looked. Drink 3 and describe what you saw.
He goes back to the sea. Everyone in shorts drinks 2.
Natural 20! He goes back to the sea. Everyone in shorts drinks 4.

cards.title: Juggler Rico
cards.rules: Juggler Rico juggles three Voltorb. Juggle any two things for five seconds or drink 3.

cards.title: Prepare for Trouble
cards.rules: Jessie and James net you from their balloon. Recite what you can of their motto, then roll d6.

outcomes.instruction: Netted. Drink 3.
Meowth scratches. Drink 2.
Wobbuffet! Give 1.
They argue about the motto. Give 2.
They blast off again. Give 2.
They blast off again! Everyone points up; the last to point drinks 3.

jinx.name: That's Right!
jinx.rule: The jinxed player ends every sentence with 'that's right!' Forget: drink 1.

cards.title: Abra
cards.rules: An Abra is asleep. It will teleport the second you move. Throw now?

cards.title: What? It's Evolving!
cards.rules: Your starter starts glowing in the middle of the road. Everyone hum the evolution music.

cards.title: Cerulean Center
cards.rules: Nurse Joy. Again. Same face, different town. Everyone points at the drawer and asks who she is.

cards.title: Cerulean Mart
cards.rules: The bike shop wants a million for a bike. The Mart next door is reasonable.

cards.title: Nugget Bridge
cards.rules: Cross the bridge with five trainers on it, or swim under it.

cards.title: Hidden Item
cards.rules: The Itemfinder beeps at a bush. Somebody kick it. The drawer gives 1.

elite.title: The Recruiter
elite.rules: The last guy on Nugget Bridge gives you a nugget, then asks you to join Team Rocket. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You signed something. Drink 8 and do the Rocket pose.
You signed something. Drink 4 and do the Rocket pose.
You keep the nugget and don't join. Give 3.
Natural 20! You keep the nugget and don't join. Give 6.

elite.title: Cooltrainer Ava
elite.rules: Cooltrainer Ava has six fully evolved Pokémon on Route 3. Rude. Roll d6.

outcomes.instruction: Her Gyarados sweeps. Drink 4.
Her Alakazam reads your mind. Drink 3 and read your last text aloud.
You sweep her back. Give 3.
She rage-quits. Give 3.
She asks for your number. Give 4.
She retires on the spot. Give 4.

cards.title: Lt. Surge
cards.rules: Lt. Surge wants to see your service record. Salute him and roll 2d6.

outcomes.instruction: Shocked. Drink 4.
You ground him. Give 4.

cards.title: Whitney
cards.rules: Whitney's Miltank used Rollout. It gets worse every hit. Roll d6.

outcomes.instruction: Rollout hits once. Drink 1.
Rollout hits twice. Drink 3.
Three hits. Drink 6.
Four hits. Drink 10.
Whitney bursts into tears. Give 5.

cards.title: Wattson
cards.rules: Wahahaha! Wattson licks a battery and dares you to do the same. Roll 2d6.

outcomes.instruction: Shocked. Drink {total}.
You lick it first. Give 5.

cards.title: Maylene
cards.rules: Maylene fights barefoot. Shoes off, then thumb-wrestle your left neighbor. Lose: drink 5.

cards.title: Burgh
cards.rules: Burgh is an artist. Draw a bug on your left neighbor's arm. Table can't name it: drink 4.

cards.title: Korrina
cards.rules: Korrina's on roller skates. Spin around 5 times, then walk a straight line. Wobble: drink 5.

cards.title: Lana
cards.rules: Lana lies about everything. Tell two truths and a lie. The table spots the lie: drink 5.

cards.title: Kabu
cards.rules: Kabu jogs every morning. Do ten jumping jacks, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Fire Spin. Take a spicy shot.
Burnt out. Drink 5, then ten more jumping jacks.
You outlast the old man. Give 5.
Natural 20! You outlast the old man. Give 10.

cards.title: Iono
cards.rules: Iono is streaming this. Say hi to chat in your best influencer voice, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Banned from chat. Finish your drink.
Chat hates you. Drink 4 and read your own hate comment aloud.
You're trending. Shout out a player by name; they drink 3.
Natural 20! Top donor. Give 8.

cards.title: Ponyta
cards.rules: Wild Ponyta. A horse on fire. Gallop around your chair once, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Trampled. Gallop in place, then drink 6.
Trampled. Gallop in place, then drink 3.
You ride it into the sunset. Give 3.
Natural 20! You ride it into the sunset. Give 6.

cards.title: Sableye
cards.rules: Wild Sableye stares at you with gem eyes from a cave. It's always staring. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It steals your soul. Drink 6 and sit in silence for 10 seconds.
It steals your soul. Drink 3 and sit in silence for 10 seconds.
You stare it down. The first player to look away from you drinks 3.
Natural 20! You stare it down. The first player to look away from you drinks 6.

cards.title: Croagunk
cards.rules: Wild Croagunk pokes you in the kidney and laughs. Poke your right neighbor, roll 2d6.

outcomes.instruction: Poison Jab. Drink 3.
You poke back harder. Give 3.

dice.doubles: A pair! Croagunk laughs at the player you poked. They drink {total}.

cards.title: Sandile
cards.rules: Wild Sandile is wearing sunglasses and doesn't care about you. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Sand in every crack. Drink 6 and squirm.
Sand in every crack. Drink 3 and squirm.
You steal the sunglasses. Wear them and give 3.
Natural 20! You steal the sunglasses. Wear them and give 6.

cards.title: Hawlucha
cards.rules: Wild Hawlucha leaps off a tree and elbow-drops the table. Slam the table, roll d6.

outcomes.instruction: Flying Press. Drink 4.
Body slam. Drink 2 while your left neighbor counts to three.
You kick out at two. Give 2.
You pin it for the three count. Give 3.
Tag team: pick a partner; you both give 2.
Off the top rope! Stand on your chair and give 4.

cards.title: Mudbray
cards.rules: Wild Mudbray is a donkey covered in mud and it wants to share. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Mud everywhere. Drink 6, and your right neighbor wipes your face.
Mud everywhere. Drink 3, and your right neighbor wipes your face.
You hose it off. The table points at the dirtiest mind here; they drink 3.
Natural 20! You hose it off. The table points at the dirtiest mind here; they drink 6.

cards.title: Biker Gang
cards.rules: A Biker on Cycling Road revs at you. Make the engine noise, roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He runs you over twice. Make the engine noise, then drink 3.
Run over. Drink {total}.
He wipes out. Give 3 to whoever looks most like they own a motorcycle.
Natural 20! He wipes out. Give 6 to whoever looks most like they own a motorcycle.

cards.title: Psychic Tyron
cards.rules: Think of a number from 1 to 5. Psychic Tyron (your left neighbor) guesses it. Right: drink 3.

cards.title: Snorlax Blocks the Way
cards.rules: A Snorlax is asleep across the road. Play the Poké Flute (hum loudly) and roll d6.

outcomes.instruction: It rolls onto you. Drink 3.
It rolls onto you and your left neighbor. You both drink 2.
It snores and doesn't move. Drink 2 and hum louder.
It wakes up and wanders off. Give 2.
It wakes up hungry. Whoever has the most food nearby drinks 2.
It wakes up and rolls away. Give 3.

cards.title: Lapras
cards.rules: A man in Silph Co. gives you a Lapras for free. Don't ask why. Take it?

cards.title: Evolution Stone
cards.rules: A shop sells evolution stones for the price of your dignity. Your starter wants one.

cards.title: Celadon Center
cards.rules: Celadon's Pokémon Center has a Game Corner next door. Everyone resists. Toast to resisting.

cards.title: Celadon Department
cards.rules: Five floors of shopping and a rooftop vending machine. The clerk is drunk.

cards.title: Game Corner
cards.rules: Walk past the Game Corner, or go in and find the poster behind the counter.

cards.title: Slot Machine
cards.rules: One more pull. You can feel it. Pull or walk?

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! The house wins. Drink 8.
The house wins. Drink 4.
Jackpot. Give 4.
Natural 20! Jackpot. Give 8.

elite.title: Rocket Executive
elite.rules: Behind the poster: a Rocket executive with a Raticate the size of a dog. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Hyper Fang to the shin. Drink 8 and hop.
Hyper Fang to the shin. Drink 4 and hop.
He drops the Silph Scope. Give 4.
Natural 20! He drops the Silph Scope. Give 8.

elite.title: Gambler Lou
elite.rules: Gambler Lou bets his whole stack on one battle. Push your drink to the middle, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You lose his money too. Drink 8.
You lose his money too. Drink 4.
You clean him out. Give 4.
Natural 20! He hands over his lucky coin too. Give 8.

cards.title: Erika
cards.rules: Erika's Sleep Powder. Shut your eyes and roll d6.

outcomes.instruction: Asleep. Drink 3 with your eyes shut.
Asleep. Drink 4 with your eyes shut.
Asleep. Drink 5 with your eyes shut.
Asleep. Drink 6 with your eyes shut.
You shake it off. Give 4.

cards.title: Morty
cards.rules: Morty's Gastly stares you down. Staring contest with the player opposite. Blink first: drink 4.

cards.title: Flannery
cards.rules: Flannery is new and nervous and set the gym on fire. Roll d6.

outcomes.instruction: Burned. Take a high-proof or spicy shot.
You douse her. Give a shot.

cards.title: Crasher Wake
cards.rules: Crasher Wake is a luchador. Put on an imaginary mask, flex at the table, and roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Piledriver. Finish your drink.
Body slam. Drink 5, then flex again.
You pin him for three. Give 5.
Natural 20! You unmask him. Give a shot.

cards.title: Elesa
cards.rules: Elesa wants a runway walk. Strut to the door and back. Table scores you under 7/10: drink 5.

cards.title: Ramos
cards.rules: Ramos is 90 and tougher than you. Talk like a grumpy grandpa, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Rototilled. Finish your drink.
Leech Seed. Drink 5, and your right neighbor steals a sip of yours.
You prune the old man. Give 5, and talk like him until your next turn.
Natural 20! You prune the old man. Give 10, and talk like him until your next turn.

cards.title: Kiawe
cards.rules: Kiawe's fire dance. Shirt off or hips going, the table picks. Then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Third-degree burns. Take a spicy shot.
Burned. Drink 5 and keep dancing.
Totem Marowak falls. Give 5.
Natural 20! Inferno Overdrive. Give a shot.

cards.title: Bea
cards.rules: Bea trains hard. Hold a plank for 30 seconds. Drop early: drink 6.

cards.title: Kofu
cards.rules: Kofu sells fish. Sell your drink to the table in 20 seconds. Nobody buys it: drink 5.

cards.title: Rocket Grunt
cards.rules: A Rocket Grunt guards the basement under the Game Corner. He has a Zubat. Of course. Roll 2d6.

outcomes.instruction: Zubat. Of course. Drink 3.
He gives up the Lift Key. Give 3.

dice.doubles: A pair! Jackpot on the slots upstairs. Give {total}.

cards.title: Slowpoke Tail Seller
cards.rules: A Grunt is selling Slowpoke Tails. They're still twitching. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You bought one. Drink 6, slowly.
You bought one. Drink 3, slowly.
You free the Slowpoke. Give 3, very slowly.
Natural 20! You free the Slowpoke. Give 6, very slowly.

cards.title: Spinner Tiles
cards.rules: Spinner tiles! A Grunt laughs while you spin in your chair. Then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Dizzy and beaten. Drink 6, then stand and walk a straight line.
Dizzy and beaten. Drink 3, then stand and walk a straight line.
You spin into him. Give 3.
Natural 20! You spin into him. Give 6.

cards.title: Giovanni
cards.rules: Giovanni strokes his Persian and doesn't look up. Roll d6.

outcomes.instruction: Persian's Slash. Drink 5.
Earthquake. Drink 4 and kiss his ring.
He looks up. Give 4.
Team Rocket disbands. For now. Give 4.
Persian switches sides. Give 4 and meow.
He says you remind him of his son. Give 5.

cards.title: Haunter
cards.rules: Wild Haunter licks you. It's cold and it lingers. Lick your lips and roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Lick. Drink 6.
Lick. Drink 3.
It vanishes, giggling. Give 3.
Natural 20! It vanishes, giggling. Give 6.

jinx.name: Mean Look
jinx.rule: Anyone who meets the jinxed player's eyes drinks 1.

cards.title: Scyther
cards.rules: Wild Scyther in the Safari Zone. It has knives for arms. Hold very still and roll d6.

outcomes.instruction: Fury Cutter, three cuts. Drink 4.
Slash. Drink 3 with no hands.
Swords Dance, but it trips. Give 2.
You slip past its blades. Give 3.
It cuts your left neighbor's hair instead. They drink 3.
It bows and leaves. Give 4.

cards.title: Tauros
cards.rules: A herd of Tauros. Everyone at the table stomps. The drawer rolls d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Stampeded. Drink 8; the loudest stomper drinks with you.
Stampeded. Drink 4; the loudest stomper drinks with you.
You ride one out. Everyone yells yeehaw; the last one drinks 3.
Natural 20! You ride one out. Everyone yells yeehaw; the last one drinks 6.

cards.title: Bronzor
cards.rules: Wild Bronzor is a frying pan that floats. It hums. Hum back, then roll 2d6.

outcomes.instruction: It hums louder. Drink 3.
You use it as a frying pan. Give 3.

dice.doubles: A pair! It rings like a gong. Everyone else drinks 2.

cards.title: Mimikyu
cards.rules: Wild Mimikyu is wearing a Pikachu costume and does not want you to look under it. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You looked. Drink 8, and don't tell anyone what you saw.
You looked. Drink 4, and don't tell anyone what you saw.
You leave its secret alone. Tell the table one of yours, then give 3.
Natural 20! You leave its secret alone. Tell the table one of yours, then give 6.

cards.title: Toxtricity
cards.rules: Wild Toxtricity air-guitars at you. Air-guitar back for five seconds, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Booed off stage. Drink 6 and play one more riff.
Booed off stage. Drink 3 and play one more riff.
Encore! Pick a bandmate: they air-guitar for five seconds or drink 3.
Natural 20! Encore! Pick a bandmate: they air-guitar for five seconds or drink 6.

cards.title: Beauty Cassandra
cards.rules: Beauty Cassandra says you're not her type. Fight her about it. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You're not. Drink 6 and compliment your left neighbor.
You're not. Drink 3 and compliment your left neighbor.
She gives you her number. It's fake. Give 3.
Natural 20! She gives you her number. It's fake. Give 6.

cards.title: Black Belt Kiyo
cards.rules: Black Belt Kiyo wants twenty push-ups. Everyone counts. Fall short: drink 3.

cards.title: Safari Zone
cards.rules: Thirty Safari Balls and a rock. Toss a napkin at your left neighbor, then roll d6.

outcomes.instruction: Everything runs. Drink 3.
You hit a Tauros with the rock. Drink 3.
Out of balls. Drink 2.
Something stays. Give 2.
A Kangaskhan, with baby. You and your left neighbor give 2 each.
A Dratini! Give 4.

cards.title: Chansey
cards.rules: A Chansey in the Safari Zone. It's carrying an egg. It runs if you breathe.

cards.title: Pokémon Tower
cards.rules: The top floor is haunted by a ghost Marowak. Climb or leave?

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Get out... get out... Drink 8.
Get out... get out... Drink 4.
You put it to rest. Give 4.
Natural 20! You put it to rest. Give 8.

cards.title: Fuchsia Center
cards.rules: Fuchsia's Center is next to a zoo with no fences. Everyone makes an animal noise and drinks 1.

cards.title: Fuchsia Mart
cards.rules: A Mart near the Safari Zone. Everything costs more because tourists.

cards.title: Cycling Road
cards.rules: Walk the long way, or bike down Cycling Road where the gang hangs out.

cards.title: Secret House
cards.rules: You find the Safari Zone's secret house. A man gives you something for no reason.

elite.title: Biker Boss
elite.rules: The gang's boss has a Weezing and a prison tattoo. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Smog in the face. Drink 10; whoever sits closest to you coughs and drinks 2.
Smog in the face. Drink 5; whoever sits closest to you coughs and drinks 1.
He respects you now and buys a round. Everyone else drinks 2.
Natural 20! He respects you now and buys a round. Everyone else drinks 4.

elite.title: Dragon Tamer
elite.rules: A Dragon Tamer in a cape on a bike path. Her Dragonite is in a hurry. Roll d6.

outcomes.instruction: Outrage. Drink 5.
Dragon Rush. Drink 4.
Thrash. Drink 3 and flail.
Tamed. Give 4.
The Dragonite gives you a lift. Give 4.
She hands you the cape. Give 5.

cards.title: Koga
cards.rules: Ninja test: within 30 seconds, sip someone else's drink without them noticing. Caught: drink 5.

cards.title: Chuck
cards.rules: Arm-wrestle the strongest player. Loser drinks 6. If they refuse, they drink 6.

cards.title: Norman
cards.rules: Norman is your dad and he's disappointed. Make the table laugh within 30 seconds or drink 6.

cards.title: Fantina
cards.rules: Fantina wants ze dance. Dance 15 seconds with no music. Table votes not magnifique: drink 5.

cards.title: Clay
cards.rules: Clay is a cowboy with a mine and no patience. Tip your hat, partner, and roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Buried in the mine. Finish your drink.
Earthquake. Yell "yeehaw", then drink 5.
You strike gold. Everyone tips their hat; the last one drinks 3.
Natural 20! You strike gold. Everyone tips their hat; the last one drinks 6.

cards.title: Clemont
cards.rules: Clemont's invention will blow. Shout "The future is now, thanks to science!" and roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Singed afro. Finish your drink.
It explodes. Drink 5 and shout the slogan again.
It works for once. Give 5.
Natural 20! Science! Everyone else drinks 3.

cards.title: Mallow
cards.rules: Mallow's cooking: splash three players' drinks into yours, then down it. Gag: drink 6.

cards.title: Opal
cards.rules: Opal wants a pink successor. Name 5 pink things in 10 seconds. Miss one: drink 5.

cards.title: Larry
cards.rules: Larry is a tired salaryman. Do your saddest desk-job sigh, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Performance review. Finish your drink.
Overtime. Drink 5 and sigh again.
You clock out early. Give 5.
Natural 20! Promoted. Give a shot.

cards.title: Gyarados
cards.rules: You fished for a Magikarp and got its angry dad. Roll 2d6.

outcomes.instruction: Hyper Beam. Drink 4.
It's yours. Somehow. Give 3.

dice.doubles: A pair! It's a red one. Give {total}.

cards.title: Lucario
cards.rules: Wild Lucario reads your aura. It knows what you did. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Aura Sphere. Drink 8 and confess what you did.
Aura Sphere. Drink 4 and confess what you did.
Your aura wins. Pick a player: they confess something or drink 3.
Natural 20! Your aura wins. Pick a player: they confess something or drink 6.

cards.title: Zoroark
cards.rules: Wild Zoroark is disguised as someone here. Accuse a player, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Wrong person. You and the accused drink 6.
Wrong person. You and the accused drink 3.
Caught it. The accused drinks 3 and admits nothing.
Natural 20! Caught it. The accused drinks 6 and admits nothing.

cards.title: Goodra
cards.rules: Wild Goodra wants a hug. It is entirely slime. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Hugged. Drink 6 and hug your right neighbor.
Hugged. Drink 3 and hug your right neighbor.
You slip out. Give 3.
Natural 20! You slip out. Give 6.

cards.title: Tinkaton
cards.rules: Wild Tinkaton has a hammer bigger than your car, and it wants your car. Roll d6.

outcomes.instruction: Gigaton Hammer. Drink 5.
Totaled. Drink 3 and name your first car.
It hammers someone else's. Whoever drove here drinks 3.
It steals a bike instead. Give 3.
It hammers itself. Give 3.
You trade it your keys. Give 4.

cards.title: Salandit
cards.rules: Wild Salandit's gas is toxic and smells like your ex. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Toxic. Hold your nose and drink 6.
Toxic. Hold your nose and drink 3.
You hold your breath and walk. Give 3.
Natural 20! You hold your breath and walk. Give 6.

cards.title: Gentleman Alfred
cards.rules: Gentleman Alfred challenges you to a battle with his Growlithe and his monocle. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Monocled. Drink 8 and speak posh until your next turn.
Monocled. Drink 4 and speak posh until your next turn.
He tips his hat. Give 3 in your poshest voice.
Natural 20! He tips his hat. Give 6 in your poshest voice.

cards.title: Fisherman Ned
cards.rules: Fisherman Ned (your left neighbor) tells a fish story. Top it. Ned wins the vote: drink 4.

cards.title: Silph Co. Maze
cards.rules: Silph Co. Eleven floors of teleport pads. Spin in your chair twice, then roll d6.

outcomes.instruction: Lost on floor 7. Drink 3.
Teleported into a meeting. Drink 2 and say "per my last email."
Back in the lobby. Drink 2 and swap seats with someone.
Found the card key. Give 2.
Found the president. Give 3.
Found the Master Ball. Give 4.

cards.title: Dratini
cards.rules: A Dratini in the Safari Zone's deepest pond. It's worth every drink.

cards.title: Rare Candy Stash
cards.rules: You find a Rare Candy behind a vending machine. Your starter is drooling.

cards.title: Saffron Center
cards.rules: A Psychic heals you with her mind. Everyone thinks a nice thought and drinks 1.

cards.title: Saffron Mart
cards.rules: A Mart in Silph's lobby, guarded by a Rocket who also works the register.

cards.title: The Fighting Dojo
cards.rules: Walk past the Fighting Dojo, or kick the door in and challenge the Karate King.

cards.title: Silph Gift
cards.rules: The Silph Co. president gives you a gift for saving the building. The drawer gives 2.

elite.title: The Karate King
elite.rules: The Karate King's Hitmonlee and Hitmonchan both want a piece of you. Roll d6.

outcomes.instruction: Hitmonlee kicks. Drink 5.
Hitmonchan punches. Drink 4.
Both. Drink 3, and pick a partner who drinks 3.
You take Hitmonlee home. Give 4.
You take Hitmonchan home. Give 4.
You take both. Give 5.

elite.title: Veteran Hugo
elite.rules: Veteran Hugo fought in a war nobody mentions. He has a Salamence. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Flamethrower. Drink 10 and tell a war story.
Flamethrower. Drink 5 and tell a war story.
Hugo salutes you. Salute back and give 4.
Natural 20! Hugo salutes you. Salute back and give 8.

cards.title: Sabrina
cards.rules: Answer 3 yes-or-no questions from the table. Any pause or lie: drink 3.

cards.title: Jasmine
cards.rules: Hold a full drink at arm's length for 30 seconds. Lower it: finish it. Make it: give 4.

cards.title: Winona
cards.rules: Drink 4 standing on a chair, flapping like a bird. Wobble off or spill: finish your drink.

cards.title: Byron
cards.rules: Byron is Roark's dad and louder about it. Shout your biggest flex at the table, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Steel beam to the face. Finish your drink.
Iron Defense. Drink 5, and the table rates your flex out of 10.
You dent the old man. Give 5.
Natural 20! You bend his steel. Everyone else drinks 3.

cards.title: Skyla
cards.rules: Skyla is your pilot. Arms out, make engine noises, then roll d20 for turbulence.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Nosedive. Finish your drink.
Turbulence. Drink 5 while your neighbors shake your chair.
Smooth landing. The table claps like passengers; give 5.
Natural 20! Mile-high club. You and a partner give 5 each.

cards.title: Valerie
cards.rules: Valerie's orders: trade an item of clothing with your right neighbor. Refuse: both drink 6.

cards.title: Olivia
cards.rules: Olivia just got dumped again. Tell her about your worst breakup, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! She dates your ex. Finish your drink.
She cries on you. Drink 6 and hug your left neighbor.
You cheer her up. Whoever had the most recent breakup drinks 4.
Natural 20! You cheer her up. Whoever had the most recent breakup drinks 8.

cards.title: Gordie
cards.rules: Gordie's mom runs the next gym and he won't shut up about it. Yell "MOM!" then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Gigantamax Coalossal. Finish your drink.
Stealth Rock. Drink 5 and yell for your mom again.
Mama's boy goes down. Give 5.
Natural 20! You call his mom. Everyone else drinks 3.

cards.title: Ryme
cards.rules: Ryme is a rapper. Freestyle four bars about your left neighbor. Table votes trash: drink 6.

cards.title: Angry Snorlax
cards.rules: A Snorlax woke up on the wrong side of the road. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Body Slam. Drink 10, then lie on the floor for 10 seconds.
Body Slam. Drink 5, then lie on the floor for 10 seconds.
It goes back to sleep. Give 3, in a whisper.
Natural 20! It goes back to sleep. Give 6, in a whisper.

cards.title: Gible's Dad
cards.rules: You poked a Gible. Its dad, a Garchomp, appeared behind it. Roll d6.

outcomes.instruction: Dragon Rush. Drink 4.
Earthquake. Everyone drinks 2.
You apologize to the family. Give 3.
Gible bites its dad. Give 3.
Sand Veil: it can't find you. Give 3.
It adopts you. Give 4.

cards.title: Hydreigon
cards.rules: Wild Hydreigon. Three heads, all hungry, none of them friendly. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! All three heads bite at once. Drink 6.
Bitten three times. Drink {total}.
The heads fight each other. Pick three players; they drink 1 each.
Natural 20! The heads fight each other. Pick three players; they drink 2 each.

cards.title: Aegislash
cards.rules: Wild Aegislash switches between sword and shield every time you swing. Roll 2d6.

outcomes.instruction: King's Shield. Drink 4.
You sheathe it. Give 3.

dice.doubles: A pair! You pull the sword out. Make a rule until your next turn.

cards.title: Dragapult
cards.rules: Wild Dragapult fires its babies at you like missiles. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Direct hit. Drink 8 and duck.
Direct hit. Drink 4 and duck.
You catch a baby. Hand it to someone: they drink 3 and coo.
Natural 20! You catch a baby. Hand it to someone: they drink 6 and coo.

cards.title: Kingambit
cards.rules: Wild Kingambit demands you kneel. Kneel, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Sliced. Drink 8 on your knees.
Sliced. Drink 4 on your knees.
You rise. Everyone else kneels; the last one down drinks 3.
Natural 20! You rise. Everyone else kneels; the last one down drinks 6.

cards.title: Ninja Boy
cards.rules: A Ninja Boy jumps out of nowhere. Was he under the table? Check, then roll d6.

outcomes.instruction: Shuriken. Drink 4.
Double Team. You and your left neighbor drink 2.
He vanishes in smoke. Give 3.
Substitute: he was a log. Give 3.
Caught him under the table. Give 4.
He was your left neighbor all along. They drink 4.

cards.title: Sage Li
cards.rules: Sage Li asks: what has keys but opens no locks? Answer in five seconds. Wrong: drink 4.

cards.title: Seafoam Currents
cards.rules: Seafoam Islands. Boulders, currents and a freezing cave. Roll d6.

outcomes.instruction: Swept away. Drink 3.
Frozen cave. Drink 2, teeth chattering.
Boulder on your foot. Drink 2 and hop.
You Strength the boulder. Give 2.
You Surf the current. Give 3.
Articuno flies over. Everyone looks up; the last one drinks 3.

cards.title: Gift Eevee
cards.rules: A man in a mansion gives you an Eevee and doesn't explain. Take it.

cards.title: It's Evolving Again!
cards.rules: Your starter is glowing mid-battle. Everyone hums the music again, louder.

cards.title: Cinnabar Center
cards.rules: A Pokémon Center on a volcano. Nurse Joy is sweating. Everyone wipes their brow.

cards.title: Cinnabar Mart
cards.rules: The last Mart before a burned-down mansion. Prices are scorched.

cards.title: Pokémon Mansion
cards.rules: Go around the burned mansion, or read the diary inside that mentions Mew.

cards.title: MissingNo.
cards.rules: A glitch flickers on the shore. Your bag could fill up. Or your save could die.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Save corrupted. Drink 10.
Save corrupted. Drink 5.
Infinite items. Give 5.
Natural 20! Infinite items. Give 10.

elite.title: Scientist Blaine Jr.
elite.rules: Blaine's nephew made a Mewtwo in a jar. He wants to test it on you. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Psystrike. Drink 10, and your left neighbor reads your mind aloud.
Psystrike. Drink 5, and your left neighbor reads your mind aloud.
The jar breaks. Run! Everyone runs in place; the slowest drinks 3.
Natural 20! The jar breaks. Run! Everyone runs in place; the slowest drinks 6.

elite.title: Burglar Sid
elite.rules: Burglar Sid is robbing the mansion and you caught him. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He robs you too. Drink 10, and your right neighbor takes a sip of your drink.
He robs you too. Drink 5, and your right neighbor takes a sip of your drink.
He leaves the loot. Give 4.
Natural 20! He leaves the loot. Give 8.

cards.title: Blaine
cards.rules: Quiz time! The table asks you 3 trivia questions. Get 2 right to win. Each miss: drink 3.

cards.title: Pryce
cards.rules: Pryce's ice bath. Chug a full glass of ice water without stopping. Stop for air: drink 5.

cards.title: Tate & Liza
cards.rules: Creepy twins. Pick a partner and speak in unison while you roll 2d6.

outcomes.instruction: They outmatch you. You both drink 5.
You hold them off. You both drink 2.

cards.title: Candice
cards.rules: Candice says focus! Hold a wall sit for 30 seconds while the table heckles. Drop: drink 6.

cards.title: Brycen
cards.rules: Brycen was a movie star. Act out a movie. Table can't name it in 20 seconds: drink 6.

cards.title: Olympia
cards.rules: Olympia has seen your future and it's bleak. Stare into her eyes, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Doomed. Finish your drink.
As foretold. Drink 6 without breaking eye contact.
You change fate. Tell a player's future; they drink 4.
Natural 20! You foresaw her loss. Everyone else drinks 4.

cards.title: Nanu
cards.rules: Nanu's a cop who can't be bothered. Get anyone to confess a crime in 30 seconds or drink 6.

cards.title: Piers
cards.rules: Piers is a punk. Scream a verse of any song like you mean it. Not punk enough: drink 6.

cards.title: Tulip
cards.rules: Tulip does your makeup. Your left neighbor mimes it, narrating every stroke. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Clown face. Finish your drink.
Hideous. Drink 6.
Gorgeous. You and your makeup artist give 3 each.
Natural 20! Supermodel. Everyone else drinks 4.

cards.title: Tyranitar
cards.rules: Wild Tyranitar kicks up a sandstorm. Cover your drink and roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Stone Edge. Drink 10; anyone whose drink wasn't covered drinks 4.
Stone Edge. Drink 5; anyone whose drink wasn't covered drinks 2.
You weather the storm. Give 4.
Natural 20! You weather the storm. Give 8.

cards.title: Metagross
cards.rules: Wild Metagross is four brains in a steel X. It already knows your roll. Roll 2d6.

outcomes.instruction: It knew. Drink 5.
It miscounted. Give 4.

dice.doubles: A pair! It did not see that coming. Give {total}.

cards.title: Volcarona
cards.rules: Wild Volcarona is a moth made of sun. Do a Quiver Dance and roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Fiery Dance. Drink 8 and keep dancing for 10 seconds.
Fiery Dance. Drink 4 and keep dancing for 10 seconds.
You out-dance it. Pick a player: they dance for 10 seconds or drink 4.
Natural 20! You out-dance it. Pick a player: they dance for 10 seconds or drink 8.

cards.title: Kommo-o
cards.rules: Wild Kommo-o rattles its scales like a metal concert. Headbang, then roll d6.

outcomes.instruction: Clangorous Soul. Drink 5.
Mosh pit. You and both neighbors drink 2.
You crowd-surf away. Give 4.
Encore. Give 4.
You steal its guitar. Give 4.
It throws you a pick. Give 5.

cards.title: Baxcalibur
cards.rules: Wild Baxcalibur has a sword for a spine and it is very cold. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Glaive Rush. Drink 10, and drink only with your off hand until your next turn.
Glaive Rush. Drink 5, and drink only with your off hand until your next turn.
It shatters. Give 4.
Natural 20! It shatters. Give 8.

cards.title: Gengar
cards.rules: Wild Gengar is behind you. No, the other side. Turn around and roll d6.

outcomes.instruction: Hypnosis. Drink 4 with your eyes shut.
Curse. You and whoever you turned toward drink 3.
It grins and fades. Give 4.
Shadow Ball misses. Give 4.
It haunts your left neighbor now. They drink 4.
It laughs so hard it vanishes. Give 5.

cards.title: Cooltrainer Duo
cards.rules: Two Cooltrainers with matching jackets and matching Dragonites. Pick a partner, roll 2d6.

outcomes.instruction: Double Outrage. You and your partner drink 4.
Their jackets are ruined. You and your partner give 2 each.

dice.doubles: A pair! Their Dragonites collide. You and your partner give 4 each.

cards.title: Pokémaniac Ed
cards.rules: Pokémaniac Ed wants the drawer to name ten Pokémon in fifteen seconds. Miss: drink 4.

cards.title: The Waterfall
cards.rules: The only way up is Waterfall. Mime climbing one, then roll d6.

outcomes.instruction: You fall. Drink 4.
You fall onto a Magikarp. Drink 3.
Halfway, then down. Drink 2.
Wet, but you hang on. Drink 1.
You make it up. Give 2.
You are the waterfall. Start one to your left; you may stop first.

cards.title: Sleeping Snorlax
cards.rules: A Snorlax asleep on the road. It's huge. It's yours if you can carry it.

cards.title: The Truck
cards.rules: There's a truck by the S.S. Anne. Everyone knows Mew is under it. Strength it?

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Nothing there. You pulled a muscle. Drink 10.
Nothing there. You pulled a muscle. Drink 5.
Mew. Kind of. Give 5.
Natural 20! Mew. Kind of. Give 10.

cards.title: Last Center
cards.rules: The last Pokémon Center before the League. Nurse Joy means it this time. Everyone toasts her.

cards.title: Last Mart
cards.rules: The last Mart before the League. Everything is Full Restores and despair.

cards.title: The Badge Gate
cards.rules: The gate guard checks your badges. Go quietly, or show off to the trainers waiting past it.

cards.title: Max Revive
cards.rules: A Max Revive in a hidden alcove. The drawer gives 2.

elite.title: Ace Trainer Rex
elite.rules: Rex says he'd be Champion if he'd tried. He has a Garchomp. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He tried. Drink 10 and say "you could be Champion, Rex."
He tried. Drink 5 and say "you could be Champion, Rex."
Rex goes home to his mom. Give 5.
Natural 20! Rex goes home to his mom. Give 10.

elite.title: Elite Four Reject
elite.rules: An Elite Four member who got fired. Still bitter. Still good. Roll 2d6.

outcomes.instruction: Still good. Drink 5.
Still fired. Give 5.

dice.doubles: A pair! You get his old job. Make a rule until your next turn.

cards.title: Giovanni
cards.rules: The mob boss of Kanto runs a gym on the side. Kiss his ring, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Team Rocket wins. Take two shots and drink 6.
Team Rocket wins. Take a shot and drink 3.
You scrape by. Drink 4.
Natural 20! You beat the boss. Everyone else finishes their drink.

cards.title: Clair
cards.rules: Clair says you're too weak for dragons. Tell her she's right, then roll 2d6.

outcomes.instruction: Dragonbreath. Drink {total}.
You tame the dragon. Give {total}.

cards.title: Wallace
cards.rules: Cross the room heel to toe, drink balanced on your head. Spill or wobble: finish it.

cards.title: Volkner
cards.rules: Volkner is so bored he blacked out the city. Bore the table with a fun fact, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Blackout. Finish your drink in the dark.
He yawns at you. Drink 6 and tell another fun fact.
You spark him up. Whoever yawned during your fact drinks 4.
Natural 20! He's finally interested. Everyone else drinks 4.

cards.title: Drayden
cards.rules: Drayden: mayor, ancient, owns a dragon. Make the table a campaign promise, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Impeached. Finish your drink.
Voted out. Drink 6 and give a concession speech.
You win the election. Appoint a cabinet: two players drink 3 each.
Natural 20! Landslide. Everyone else drinks 5.

cards.title: Wulfric
cards.rules: Wulfric loves a bear hug. Hug three players on one breath. Breathe early: drink 7.

cards.title: Hapu
cards.rules: Hapu's Mudsdale stomps. Stomp your feet like a horse, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Buried in mud. Finish your drink.
Trampled. Stomp three times, then drink 7.
You ride her horse. Pick a player: they neigh for you or drink 4.
Natural 20! Island Kahuna. Everyone else drinks 4.

cards.title: Raihan
cards.rules: Raihan takes a selfie mid-battle. Pose for his phone, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Posted and roasted. Finish your drink.
Sandstorm. Drink 6, and the table writes your caption.
You trend. Take a selfie with a player; they drink 4.
Natural 20! Most-liked post ever. Everyone else drinks 4.

cards.title: Grusha
cards.rules: Grusha wrecked his knees snowboarding. Wall-sit for 30 seconds. Drop early: drink 7.

cards.title: Golurk
cards.rules: A Golurk guards Victory Road: a robot made of clay and grudges. Roll d6.

outcomes.instruction: Hammer Arm. Drink 5.
Heavy Slam. Drink 4.
It holds a grudge. Drink 3; your left neighbor says what for.
It crumbles. Give 4.
It lets you pass. Give 4.
It carries you up the road. Give 5.

cards.title: Steelix
cards.rules: A Steelix is the floor of the cave. You've been walking on it. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It wakes up. Drink 10, and whisper until your next turn.
It wakes up. Drink 5, and whisper until your next turn.
You tiptoe off it. Give 4.
Natural 20! You tiptoe off it. Give 8.

cards.title: Machamp
cards.rules: Wild Machamp. Four arms, no shirt, very personal. Roll 2d6.

outcomes.instruction: Four punches at once. Drink 5.
You hug it into submission. Give 4.

dice.doubles: A pair! It high-fives the table with all four arms. Everyone else drinks 2.

cards.title: Boulder Puzzle
cards.rules: Victory Road's boulder puzzle. You pushed one wrong and now you're stuck. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Restart the puzzle. Drink 8 and swap seats with your left neighbor.
Restart the puzzle. Drink 4 and swap seats with your left neighbor.
Solved. Give 3, smugly.
Natural 20! Solved. Give 6, smugly.

cards.title: Veteran Ada
cards.rules: Veteran Ada wants to see your badges. Name all eight from this run. Miss one: drink 4.

cards.title: Indigo Plateau
cards.rules: The Pokémon Center at the top of Victory Road. Nobody talks. Everyone drinks 1 in silence.

cards.title: Indigo Mart
cards.rules: The Indigo Plateau Mart. Last chance, highest prices.

cards.title: Two Ladders
cards.rules: Two ladders. One leads up. The other leads to the Ace Trainers nobody warned you about.

elite.title: Ace Trainer Ilse
elite.rules: Ace Trainer Ilse has six Pokémon and no mercy. Roll d6 for how many you beat.

outcomes.instruction: None. Drink 6.
One. Drink 5.
Two. Drink 4.
Three. Drink 3.
Five of six. Give 4.
All six. Give 6.

elite.title: Ace Trainer Ben
elite.rules: Ace Trainer Ben has been on Victory Road for nine years. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Nine years of practice. Drink 10, and tell the table what you'd do with nine years.
Nine years of practice. Drink 5, and tell the table what you'd do with nine years.
Ben finally goes home. Give 5.
Natural 20! Ben finally goes home. Give 10.

cards.title: Blue
cards.rules: Smell ya later! Your rival shows up again with a full team and a haircut. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He smells ya. Drink 10 and sniff your own armpit.
He smells ya. Drink 5 and sniff your own armpit.
He cries to Grandpa. Give 4 and say "smell ya later."
Natural 20! He cries to Grandpa. Give 8 and say "smell ya later."

cards.title: Silver
cards.rules: Silver stole his starter and wants to steal yours. Roll d6.

outcomes.instruction: Stolen. Drink 5.
He steals your seat. Drink 3 and swap seats with your left neighbor.
He learns to love his Pokémon. Give 4.
He calls you a wimp, then cries. Give 4.
He hands back your starter. Give 4.
He calls his dad. It's Giovanni. Give 5.

cards.title: Wally
cards.rules: Wally got healthy. Wally got strong. Wally has a Gallade. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Wally is so strong now. Drink 10 and cheer for him.
Wally is so strong now. Drink 5 and cheer for him.
Wally needs his inhaler. Everyone else takes a deep breath and drinks 2.
Natural 20! Wally needs his inhaler. Everyone else takes a deep breath and drinks 4.

cards.title: Barry
cards.rules: Barry runs into you and fines you ten million. Roll 2d6.

outcomes.instruction: Pay up. Drink 5.
He runs off to fine someone else. Pick who; they drink 4.
